comparative.perPairValue: AdvantageRatio r = csharpSize / calorSize, where size = cube root of (tokens x non-whitespace characters x lines) of the arm's source file; tokens from TokenEconomicsCalculator.TokenizeSource.
comparative.direction: r > 1 means the C# source file is larger than the Calor source file; r < 1 means it is smaller.
comparative.whySymmetric: One tokenizer, one character rule, and one line rule are applied to both source texts. No term is defined per language.
comparative.interpretation: Measures the size of these two files as written, including each arm's boilerplate. It is a static source-size measure, not a measure of either language in general.

descriptiveOnly.reason: Combines parse success with StructureCompleteness, which scores Calor AST node kinds and C# syntax node kinds with separate per-language rules (CalculateCalorStructureScore vs CalculateCSharpStructureScore).
Scores Calor markers and C# patterns with separate per-language rules (CalculateCalorClarityScore vs CalculateCSharpClarityScore).
Credits Calor unique-ID targeting and C# structural patterns with separate per-language rules (CalculateCalorEditPrecision vs CalculateCSharpEditPrecision).
Scores detection factors with separate per-language rules (CalculateCalorErrorDetectionCapability vs CalculateCSharpErrorDetectionCapability).
Counts semantic elements with separate per-language counters (CountCalorSemanticElements vs CountCSharpSemanticElements).
Scores stability with separate per-language rules (CalculateCalorStability vs CalculateCSharpStability).
Without an LLM provider this is a structural estimate that awards points for language-specific constructs (for example Calor contracts and Option handling vs C# null checks); it executes no code.

descriptiveOnlyRule: A descriptive-only metric enters no ratio, advantage, win count, interval, headline, or category ranking. If reported at all, each arm's mean is shown separately and labeled 'static feature score with a language-specific definition; not comparable across arms'. The reason for each entry is its definition in the pinned implementation file, read before any oracle run; it does not depend on any equivalence outcome or metric value.
notInThisSet: The other calculators in tests/Calor.Evaluation/Metrics (TaskCompletion, Safety, EffectDiscipline, LlmEvaluation, AgentRefactoring, InteropEffectCoverage) are not in BenchmarkRunner's static run and are not registered here. The LLM- and agent-based ones need paid providers (0 USD ceiling, contract section 9); their past results are historical-only in the inventory (llm-and-agent-results).
claim: Every metric here is a static feature score of two committed files. None is a coding-agent outcome, and none is presented as a measured language, productivity, correctness, or safety advantage (contract benchmarkEquivalence.claimRule).
